violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: Pooled raw shell eggs=55F. Pooled she eggs were observed storied at room temperature, with no visible signs of tempearture control.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. CORRECTED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Unsalted butter=55F, whopped cream=63F, roasted mushroom=55F, sautéed onions=53F, blue cheese=51F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides.OBSERVED INSECTICIDE DESIGNED FOR HOUSEHOLD USE ONLY , USE USED IN THE FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. These pesticides shall not be used. The two insecticide bottles were discarded by the CFM, during the inspection.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED TOXIC CLEANING CHEMICAL IN UNMARKED SPRAY BOTTLE.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. BOTTLES DISCARDED DURING THE ISNPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED LIQUID FOOD ITEMS IN UNMARKED SQUEEZE BOTTLES WITHOUT LABELS TO IDENTIFY CONTENTS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. SOME OF THE EMPLOYEES WERE OBSERVED WEARING BRACELETS WHILE THEY WERE PREPARING FOODS IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CORRECTED.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3-COMPARTMENT SINK piping are leaking. IT WAS NOTED THAT ONE OF THE PIPES IS TOO SHORT AND DOES NOT REACH THE FLOOR DRAIN, CAUSING WATER TO POOL ON THE FLOOR, WHENEVER THE SINK IS DRAINED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Fix this violation at the soonest possible time.,
